repairs.quote: Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing (55/72.5/90/107.5/125 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal 60% less damage. Casts on worked ground cost 10 Mana and have 50% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds, dealing (99/130.5/162/193.5/225 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for 3 seconds. Taliyah can move and use other Abilities while hurling rocks. Casting this Ability on Worked Ground cannot reduce its Cooldown to less than 0.75 seconds. Total damage to a single target: (143/188.5/234/279.5/325 + (130% Ability Power)) Each rock deals 20/25/30/35/40 additional damage to monsters.
